containerOverrides.name: dbtools
command: set -e; SRC="$(echo "$DATABASE_URL" | sed "s/?.*$//")?sslmode=require"; S=$(date +%s); pg_dump "$SRC" -Fc --no-owner --no-privileges -f /tmp/d.pgc; echo "DUMP_BYTES=$(wc -c < /tmp/d.pgc)"; psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -c "DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS public CASCADE; CREATE SCHEMA public;" 2>/dev/null; echo SCHEMA_RESET_OK; pg_restore -d "$PGDATABASE" --no-owner --no-privileges /tmp/d.pgc; E=$(date +%s); echo "TOTAL_SECONDS=$((E-S))"; echo "--- counts (RDS -> Supabase) ---"; FAIL=0; for t in User Account Session Project Chapter Scene Character CharacterNote WorldNote PlotThread Foreshadowing RevisionTodo TimelineEvent Mystery ApiToken Subscription OAuthClient OAuthGrant OAuthToken ReadingProgress MutationLog AuditLog _prisma_migrations; do   A=$(psql "$SRC" -t -A -c "SELECT count(*) FROM \"$t\"" 2>/dev/null || echo ERR);   B=$(psql -t -A -c "SELECT count(*) FROM \"$t\"" 2>/dev/null || echo ERR);   if [ "$A" = "$B" ]; then M=OK; else M=MISMATCH; FAIL=1; fi;   echo "$t: $A -> $B  $M"; done; if [ "$FAIL" = "1" ]; then echo "COUNT_MISMATCH - DO NOT PROCEED"; exit 1; fi; echo MIGRATE_DONE
